steps: cd /tmp/crush-install && v=$(cat version) && f=crush_${v}_Linux_arm64.tar.gz && curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v$v/$f" && curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v$v/checksums.txt" && grep " $f\$" checksums.txt | sha256sum -c -

cd /tmp/crush-install && v=$(cat version) && tar -xzof crush_${v}_Linux_arm64.tar.gz && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && cp crush_${v}_Linux_arm64/crush "$HOME/.local/bin/.crush.new" && chmod 755 "$HOME/.local/bin/.crush.new" && mv -f "$HOME/.local/bin/.crush.new" "$HOME/.local/bin/crush"

cd /tmp/crush-install && v=$(cat version) && f=crush_${v}_Linux_arm64.tar.gz && curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v$v/$f" && curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v$v/checksums.txt" && grep " $f\$" checksums.txt | sha256sum -c -

cd /tmp/crush-install && v=$(cat version) && tar -xzof crush_${v}_Linux_arm64.tar.gz && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && cp crush_${v}_Linux_arm64/crush "$HOME/.local/bin/.crush.new" && chmod 755 "$HOME/.local/bin/.crush.new" && mv -f "$HOME/.local/bin/.crush.new" "$HOME/.local/bin/crush"

signIn.note: On first start Crush asks for a provider and its API key (or set one, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY, in this machine's environment).
